name: Chevron
notes: Revenue = 'Total revenues and other income' (incl. equity-affiliate and other income; excise taxes included in sales in earlier years as reported). Chevron reports no operating income line, so operatingIncome is derived for every year (quality estimated) as income (from continuing operations) before income tax expense plus 'Interest and debt expense' (zero in 2008 and 2011-2015, when it was capitalized). Equity-affiliate income and other income (which holds interest income and asset-sale gains) stay in, as the face of the statement does not separate them. 2000-2003 are ChevronTexaco figures (Texaco merger 2001, pooling-restated 2000). 2004-2006 are continuing operations. 2007+ from SEC XBRL company facts, values as last reported in later 10-Ks. FY ends Dec 31.
